snippet.title: SPIKEVENTURE: RELEASE TRAILER [SMBX2]
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD LINK:
https://www.smbxgame.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=29495

This is the trailer for a Mario fangame I've been working on for a good while now, SPIKEVENTURE! Barrel through 11 levels packed with action, challenge, and loads of secrets as a Spike! And yes, this is a release trailer! Meaning you can play it right now! Seriously! Click the above link to download it!

Music:
Yoshi's Island - Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island | Koji Kondo
Sand Canyon 1 - Kirby's Dream Land 3 | Jun Ishikawa
